Chloe / team — quick update from the engineering side: FYI we learned this morning that Acmes CFO and procurement leads will be at an offsite Dec 9-11 for annual vendor reviews. Thats triggering an internal procurement blackout until the FY reset (they specifically mentioned a short spend freeze through the end of the month while they finalize year-end allocations).

Given that, the primary stakeholders Kyle and Roshni may not be able to commit to decisions that week. I recommend we offer two options to be pragmatic:

- Option A: Move the technical briefing to the week of Dec 28 — Jan 1 is a holiday gap, so earliest business week after FY reset would be Jan 5–8.
- Option B: Keep a short 30-min alignment on Dec 10 with Acmes engineering-only attendees (if anyone else on their team is available) to cover integration constraints, then book the procurement/exec-facing session for early January.

Notes: if they choose Option A we should use the extra time to produce a short integration runbook and a draft mutual action plan to accelerate PO once their freeze lifts. I attached a quick integration-notes.pdf with compatibility highlights.

- Dev
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.com

Team — thanks for the heads up, Dev. Kyle / Roshni: sorry to hear about the offsite timing — that happens every year. From a commercial perspective Id prefer we avoid burning SE cycles if the decision-makers are in a procurement blackout. Two recommended approaches:

1) Postpone the full briefing until the week of Jan 5 (Jan 6 at 11:00 AM EST would work for me) so we can ensure procurement and IT leadership are present and able to move forward.

2) If Kyle wants immediate technical validation, we can run a 30-min engineer-to-engineer session on Dec 10 but flag that pricing/terms/PO can only be finalized post-freeze. Ill prepare a one-page mutual action plan and a short pricing estimate we can iterate on.

Let me know which you prefer. Ill update HubSpot and send a new calendar invite once we agree. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/ACME-ACCT/record/ACME-2026-Q4-42

Roshni will confirm a PO timeline closer to the new year. In the meantime, Id like Option B: a 30-min engineering sync on Dec 10 at 11:00 AM if your SEs are available — Kyle & our infra lead will join for technical questions only.

Chloe / Aditya: please send a short runbook and the one-page MAP before Dec 10 so the infra team can review.

See you all soon — happy holidays.

—Kyle
